title: SYNES university lecturers' warning stoppage
organizer: Syndicat national des enseignants du supérieur (SYNES)
threshold_50_evidence: No public gathering of 50 or more established.

start_date.summary: Koaci says stoppage began January25; DataCameroon January26 observes partial Douala teaching boycott on January25. January30 is announced end only.

organizer.summary: Syndicat national des enseignants du supérieur (SYNES)

demands.summary: Unpaid research bonuses and academic-service payments; demand addressed to public universities/ministry.

threshold_50_evidence.summary: S009/S031 verify a teaching stoppage, not a physical public gathering. More than200 teachers concerned is neither an assembly count nor evidence of >=50 assembled.

end_date.summary: Actual physical end not established; no scheduled end or last publication treated as observed closure.

notes: Koaci reports strike begun January25 and >200 teachers concerned; DataCameroon observes partial Douala class stoppage. These teachers are not a counted public assembly. Demands unpaid research bonuses and academicservice payments from state universities/ministry. January30 is scheduled end only. Ministry payment promise and referral to Finance do not establish formal reception/negotiation. Occurrence of a public assembly is itself unverified: teaching boycott is observed, physical gathering is not. Ministry communication is a future payment promise, neither observed payment nor formal negotiation.
open_questions: Response to this assembly, distinct from grievances?
